instruction_units.title: 1. LH Leap To Chord
instruction_units.instruction: The left hand moves from Eb5 on m.55, beat 2.25 to an C4-C4-Eb4-Eb4-F4-F4-Ab4-Ab4-C5-C5 chord on m.55, beat 4.

instruction_units.title: 2. Melody with accompaniment
instruction_units.instruction: Both hands form a melody-with-accompaniment texture at m.54: one layer carries the melodic line while another supplies aligned support. Melody Gb5-Db6 over accompaniment Ab4.

instruction_units.title: 3. LH Chord Landing
instruction_units.instruction: The left hand sounds C4-C4-Eb4-Eb4-F4-F4-Ab4-Ab4-C5-C5 (10 notes, span 12 semitones) on m.55, beat 4.
